km.id AS master_id, km.code AS master_code, km.name AS master_name, km.type_code AS master_type_code,
kc.id AS cat_id, kc.name AS cat_name,
child_ka.id AS child_asm_id, child_ka.target_value AS child_asm_target, child_ka.mid_self_score AS child_mid_score, child_ka.end_self_score AS child_end_score, child_ka.end_pm_score AS child_pm_score, child_ka.status_code AS child_status_code, child_ka.evidences AS child_evidences,
child_u.id AS child_user_id, child_u.full_name AS child_full_name,
child_jt.id AS child_jt_id, child_jt.name AS child_jt_name
FROM kpi_assignments pm_ka JOIN kpis_information ki ON pm_ka.kpi_info_id = ki.id AND ki.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN kpi_master km ON ki.master_kpi_id = km.id AND km.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN kpi_categories kc ON km.category_id = kc.id AND kc.deleted_at IS NULL
LEFT JOIN kpi_assignments child_ka ON child_ka.parent_assignment_id = pm_ka.id AND child_ka.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN users child_u ON child_ka.user_id = child_u.id AND child_u.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN job_titles child_jt ON child_u.job_title_id = child_jt.id AND child_jt.deleted_at IS NULL

mapper.select: SELECT ka.id AS assignment_id, ka.cycle_id AS cycle_id, ka.status_code AS status_code, asm.name AS status_name, asm.description AS status_description, ka.user_id AS user_id, u.full_name AS user_full_name, u.username AS user_username, km.code AS master_code, km.name AS master_name, ki.target_description AS target_description, ki.weight AS weight, ki.is_important AS important, kc.name AS category_name, km.type_code AS type_code FROM kpi_assignments ka JOIN kpis_information ki ON ka.kpi_info_id = ki.id AND ki.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN kpi_master km ON ki.master_kpi_id = km.id AND km.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN kpi_categories kc ON km.category_id = kc.id AND kc.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN users u ON ka.user_id = u.id AND u.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN sys_status_codes asm ON asm.code = ka.status_code AND asm.category = 'ASM_STATUS' WHERE ka.cycle_id = #{cycleId, jdbcType=OTHER} AND ka.deleted_at IS NULL AND ka.user_id IS NOT NULL AND ka.status_code IN (401, 402, 403) ORDER BY CASE ka.status_code WHEN 403 THEN 0 WHEN 402 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, kc.name, km.code, u.full_name
